title: festuca ovina var. caesia
intro: Festuca ovina var. caesia, commonly known as blue fescue, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina var. caesia include expectorant and mucolytic actions, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
